name: Non-Immigrant ED Visa (Student)

requirement_groups.name: Admitted to a Ministry of Education-approved institution

requirements.blocker_text: Requires admission to a university, language school, or other institution approved by Thailand's Ministry of Education, which issues a support letter for the visa application.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission and a support letter from a Ministry of Education-approved Thai institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of sufficient funds for tuition and living costs for the duration of study.
requirements.fix_path: Provide bank statements, a scholarship award letter, or a sponsor's financial guarantee.

evidence_required.document: Support letter from the Ministry of Education-approved institution
90-day address reporting to Immigration Bureau once resident

outcome.duration_length: 90 days initially, extendable annually for the duration of study

sources.title: HelloThailand -- Thailand Long Term Visa Options in 2026, describing the Non-ED student visa category alongside other long-stay routes

HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of a Royal Thai Government immigration or education-ministry page was achieved for this route's specific mechanics in this research pass. work_rights is correctly 'none': unlike several countries in this dataset, Thailand's Non-ED student visa carries no part-time work allowance at all -- students found working, including informal or remote arrangements, risk visa cancellation and deportation, a genuinely stricter position than Poland's uncapped or Korea's/Denmark's capped student work rights documented elsewhere in this dataset. No dedicated post-graduation job-search permit was identified for this route in sources checked for this build -- the standard path from student status to work status is a direct conversion to Non-B (with an employer's work permit sponsorship) or, for qualifying tech/BOI-target-industry graduates, the SMART visa.
